channel.title: The Modern Schoolhouse
channel.description: A K-12 education blog on school choice, teaching trends, and student success

item.title: Why Charter School Enrollment Is at an All-Time High
item.description: Charter schools now serve nearly 4 million students nationally. Here's what the record enrollment surge reveals about what families really want from public education.

item.title: School Culture: The School-Choice Factor You Can't Ignore
item.description: Most families compare test scores and class sizes. But school culture — a school's values, identity, and community — may matter even more. Here's how to evaluate it.

item.title: AI Literacy Is Now a Core K-12 Skill. Are Schools Ready?
item.description: 80% of K-12 students feel unprepared for AI. Here's why charter schools are best positioned to close that gap before graduation.

item.title: Why How You Teach Matters as Much as What You Teach
item.description: NAEP reading scores keep falling. Research shows explicit, teacher-directed instruction produces far bigger gains. Here's what the evidence says—and what families should ask.

item.title: Tuition-Free Online Charter Schools: What You Actually Get
item.description: Online charter schools are tuition-free public schools—but what do families actually get? Real teachers, real tech, and real accountability, explained.

item.title: Student Mental Health 2025: How Charter Schools Close the Gap
item.description: Youth mental health is in crisis. Here's how charter schools' smaller communities, SEL-first cultures, and flexible models are stepping up where large districts fall short.

item.title: How Charter Schools Are Closing the College Access Gap
item.description: The postsecondary enrollment gap for low-income students is real and persistent. Here's how integrated charter school networks are building K-12-to-career pipelines that actually close it.

item.title: The Attendance Crisis: What Schools Can Do Right Now
item.description: Chronic absenteeism still affects 22% of U.S. students. Here's what research says schools—including charters—can do to reverse the trend.

item.title: Why Class Size Is the Hidden Engine of K-8 Success
item.description: Research proves small K-8 class sizes drive real academic gains. Here's what the evidence says—and why it belongs on every school-choice family's checklist.

item.title: How PBIS Builds School Culture at Charter High Schools
item.description: Learn how PBIS frameworks help charter high schools build positive culture, cut suspensions, and keep more students engaged and on track to graduate.

item.title: Universal School Choice Is Here: What ESAs Actually Cover
item.description: 13+ states now offer universal ESAs. Here's what the funds actually cover—tuition, therapy, tutoring, and more—and how to use them.

item.title: The Attendance Crisis: How Flexible Schools Help
item.description: Chronic absenteeism still affects nearly 1 in 4 students. Here's why flexible and virtual charter schools are uniquely built to solve it.

item.title: AI Literacy in K-12: Why It's an Equity Issue
item.description: AI literacy is now a K-12 equity issue. Learn what it means, why underserved students are most at risk, and how charter schools can close the gap.

item.title: STEM Meets Leadership: The Charter School Model That Does Both
item.description: How charter schools are fusing cross-curricular STEM with student leadership programs—and why this whole-child approach is redefining what K-12 success looks like.

item.title: Why Small Rural Charter Schools Win on Belonging
item.description: Small rural charter schools have a structural edge on belonging—and research shows belonging drives achievement. Here's what that means for rural school choice.

item.title: Earning College Credit in High School: What Parents Should Know
item.description: More than 2.5 million high schoolers now earn college credit before graduation. Here's what concurrent enrollment means for your family—and your wallet.

item.title: When School Is Too Slow: Online Charters for Advanced Kids
item.description: Advanced students are often bored and unchallenged in traditional schools. Here's how online charter schools meet gifted learners where they are.

item.title: Why Parents Are Switching Schools in 2025
item.description: New 2025 data reveals what's really driving families to change schools—and what it means for how parents should evaluate their options.

item.title: The Public Homeschool: Why Charter Schools Beat Going It Alone
item.description: More families are choosing independent study charter schools over private homeschooling. Here's what they gain: public funding, a credentialed teacher, IEP access, and an accredited diploma.

item.title: Why Students Skip School—And Why Families Leave
item.description: Chronic absenteeism has doubled since the pandemic. Here's how the crisis is reshaping school choice—and why some families are finding better fits elsewhere.
